messages:
maya: Heads-up from Sales: large pilots keep stalling because customers want to ramp commits over a quarter. They asked for a staged-commit plan that still guarantees demo performance.
raj: Got it. The tricky part is mapping staged commits to Dedicated reservations. We treat reservations month-by-month now.
katie: Proposal: "staged reserve" product that buys a small reserved baseline + a pilot addon guaranteeing throughput for X days. If they convert, baseline scales into full reserved commit.
liam: From infra: option A = spin isolated pilot pools (high cost), option B = soft-reserve weight + throttles in scheduler (lower cost).
samir-bizdev: GTM prefers B if we can promise SLAs for the pilot window. We can price it as a premium on top of equivalent reserve rate.
maya: Sales also needs an eligibility rule so self-serve doesn't consume reserved capacity. We should gate to Sales-approved or >$Z ARR accounts.
raj: Legal asks for explicit wording around auto-convert vs optional convert. Also need a refund policy for unused pilot days.
katie: Launch checklist draft: 1) billing flow (pilot addon sku) 2) console toggle to enable pilot addon 3) routing policy + fallback mapping 4) contract clause + checkbox for auto-convert 5) monitoring/alerts.
liam: Routing policy sketch: pilot weight -> pilot burst buffer -> compatible fallback variant -> hosted. We'll enforce a per-pool max simultaneous pilot count.
maya: Can we have a simple UX: checkbox "Convert pilot charges to reservation credit if signed within N days"? Sales hates manual accounting.
raj: Fine, but require explicit consent. Legal wants a conversion rate table in contract (e.g., pilot surcharge converts at 75% credit).
samir-bizdev: Pricing call: three pilot tiers (30/60/90 days) with flat setup + per-day guarantee surcharge. If customer converts within the window, surcharge becomes credit toward commit at conversion-rate.
katie: Beta scope recommendation: single region, single model family, manual provisioning for pilot addon (reduce automation). Aim for private beta in 6 weeks.
liam: Ops note: need an internal sim to estimate per-token cost delta for pilot isolation. I'll open ticket and tag infra bench.
ops-bot: Created INF-4233 "staged-reserve pilot sim" assigned to liam. ETA 10 business days.
maya: Risk list: capacity leakage, confused billing, resale of pilot guarantees. Raj, can you draft a two-paragraph risks note for execs?
raj: On it. Will include mitigation: gating, hard caps, clear contract language.
samir-bizdev: I'll prepare sample pricing table and one-pager for Sales to use.
katie: Action owners: katie spec + pricing draft, liam ops sim + routing design, raj legal language, samir sales kit. Sync next Tue 10am.
maya: Thanks team. Keeping timeline tight but pragmatic. :rocket:
